# Fix PDF render errors


## Purpose

Use this guide when a Quarto Typst PDF briefing fails to render or renders but does not look right.

For the incidence briefing:

```text
site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/pdf/case-incidence-pdf.qmd
```

Standard render command:

```powershell
cd C:\yoshimi-hot\output\analyse-bnr\info-hub\site
quarto render surveillance/cvd/briefings/pdf/case-incidence-pdf.qmd --to typst
```

# Stage 1: Check the PDF QMD location

The HTML QMD sits in the main briefing folder. Keep its PDF QMD in the `pdf/` subfolder:

```text
site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/case-incidence.qmd
site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/pdf/case-incidence-pdf.qmd
```

# Stage 2: Check the YAML header

A simple Typst PDF header looks like this:

```yaml
---
bibliography: []
citeproc: false
csl: apa
format:
  typst:
    output-file: bnr_cvd_incidence_2023_v1.pdf
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
    papersize: us-letter
    margin:
      top: 1.8cm
      bottom: 1.7cm
      left: 1.8cm
      right: 1.8cm
    mainfont: "Noto Sans"
    font-paths:
      - "../../../../assets/fonts/noto-sans"
    fontsize: 10pt
    linkcolor: "#e87a00"
    fig-cap-location: bottom
---
```

:::{.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## Avoid `csl: null`

Do not use:

```yaml
csl: null
```

Quarto expects `csl` to be a string.
:::

# Stage 3: Check inherited bibliography errors

If the PDF fails with:

```text
unknown style: https://www.zotero.org/styles/harvard-cite-them-right
```

add:

```yaml
bibliography: []
citeproc: false
csl: apa
```

# Stage 4: Check image paths

If the PDF QMD sits here:

```text
site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/pdf/case-incidence-pdf.qmd
```

then image paths to the site download folder usually start with:

```text
../../../../downloads/files/briefings/cvd_incidence_2023_v1/figures/
```

Example:

```markdown
![Annual CVD incidence](../../../../downloads/files/briefings/cvd_incidence_2023_v1/figures/cvd_incidence_annual.png){width=100%}
```

# Stage 5: Understand where the PDF is created

When rendering inside a Quarto website project, the PDF is generated under `_site/`:

```text
site/_site/surveillance/cvd/briefings/pdf/bnr_cvd_incidence_2023_v1.pdf
```

This is expected. Do not edit `_site/` directly.

# Stage 6: Check the visual result

After a successful render, open the PDF and check:

- title block
- logo placement if used
- figure size and clarity
- page breaks
- font readability
- absence of private paths
- citation/build note if included
